facets.description: GroupTest concurrency test: the reader thread is never joined before assertThat, so exceptions thrown late (or by an in-flight read) get added after the assertion runs, and the test can pass when it should fail
GroupTest concurrency test can pass without testing anything: the reader loop may never run while deletes are happening, so caughtExceptions is empty by default
GroupTest concurrency test: deletedAll.set(true) is not in a finally block, so if a delete throws, the non-daemon reader thread loops forever and the test hangs
